dt: Nomination period Oct 15 - Jan 15, annually; this cycle closes Jan 15, 2027
e: Recognizes early-career researchers in the sensor field who completed their PhD within 10 years of the nomination deadline and are lead or contact author on at least two papers in an ECS journal on Sensor Division topics. Nominees must be ECS members with the Sensor Division as their primary division.
n: ECS Sensor Division Early Career Award
unv: The page gives the annual Oct 15 - Jan 15 window; the 2027 closing date is taken from that annual window.
